recipes.name: Kanda Batata Poha
recipes.description: Fluffy flattened rice tempered with mustard, curry leaves, onion, and soft potato cubes — a classic Maharashtrian breakfast.
recipes.notes: Rinse poha briefly so flakes stay soft, not mushy. Lemon and sev at the end are traditional.

steps.title: Rinse poha
steps.instruction: Place poha in a colander, rinse under cold water 10–15 seconds, drain well, and fluff with salt, turmeric, and sugar. Rest 5 minutes.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat oil. Add mustard seeds; when they crackle, add peanuts, curry leaves, and green chilli. Fry peanuts until golden.

steps.title: Onion and potato
steps.instruction: Add chopped onion; sauté until translucent. Add diced potato with a splash of water, cover, and cook until tender.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fold in poha gently. Cover on low heat 2 minutes. Off heat, add lemon juice and coriander. Top with sev if using.

recipes.name: Soft Rava Upma
recipes.description: Savory semolina porridge with tempering, vegetables, and a soft spoonable texture.
recipes.notes: Use ghee for richer flavor; swap oil and skip ghee for a dairy-free version.

steps.title: Roast rava
steps.instruction: Dry-roast rava on medium heat until fragrant and pale golden. Set aside.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat ghee. Add mustard seeds, urad dal, and chana dal. When dals turn golden, add curry leaves, chilli, and ginger.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.instruction: Add onion; sauté until soft. Stir in carrot and peas; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Cook upma
steps.instruction: Pour in salted boiling water. Lower heat and rain in roasted rava while stirring. Cover and steam 3–4 minutes until soft. Finish with lemon and coriander.
steps.tip: Keep water hot before adding rava to avoid lumps.

recipes.name: Aloo Paratha
recipes.description: Whole-wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced mashed potato, cooked on a tawa until blistered.
recipes.notes: Freeze uncooked stuffed discs between parchment; cook from frozen with a little extra time.

steps.title: Knead dough
steps.instruction: Mix atta with 0.5 tsp salt and enough water to make a soft dough. Rest covered 15 minutes.

steps.title: Make filling
steps.instruction: Mash potatoes. Mix chilli, ginger, spice powders, amchur, coriander, and remaining salt until lump-free.

steps.title: Stuff and roll
steps.instruction: Divide dough into balls. Flatten, place a scoop of filling, seal, and roll gently into 6–7 inch discs.

steps.title: Cook on tawa
steps.instruction: Cook on a hot tawa, flipping and brushing with ghee, until both sides are golden with brown spots. Serve with dahi or pickle.

recipes.name: Gobi Paratha
recipes.description: Tawa-cooked whole-wheat paratha filled with grated cauliflower and warming spices.
recipes.notes: Squeeze grated cauliflower dry so the filling does not tear the dough.

steps.title: Dough
steps.instruction: Knead soft atta dough with salt and water. Rest 15 minutes.

steps.title: Filling
steps.instruction: Squeeze grated cauliflower. Mix with finely chopped onion, chilli, ginger, ajwain, turmeric, garam masala, coriander, and salt.

steps.title: Stuff
steps.instruction: Stuff dough balls with filling, seal carefully, and roll without tearing.

steps.title: Cook
steps.instruction: Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until crisp and spotted. Serve hot with butter or yogurt.

recipes.name: Paneer Paratha
recipes.description: Soft atta paratha stuffed with crumbled paneer, green chilli, and herbs.
recipes.notes: Do not over-salt fresh paneer; taste the filling before stuffing.

steps.title: Dough
steps.instruction: Knead soft atta dough; rest 15 minutes.

steps.title: Paneer filling
steps.instruction: Crumble paneer. Mix chilli, ginger, chaat masala, cumin, coriander, and salt.

steps.title: Roll
steps.instruction: Stuff, seal, and roll gently so paneer stays enclosed.

steps.title: Cook
steps.instruction: Cook on a medium-hot tawa with ghee until golden on both sides. Serve with mint chutney.

recipes.name: Home-Style Misal
recipes.description: Sprouted moth bean curry in a tangy, spicy gravy topped with farsan, onion, and lemon — a Mumbai-style breakfast bowl.
recipes.notes: Farsan and pav add gluten; use gluten-free sev and skip pav if needed. Matki sprouts can be swapped with moong.

steps.title: Cook sprouts
steps.instruction: Pressure-cook or simmer sprouts with turmeric and salt until just tender but intact. Drain, reserving cooking liquid.

steps.title: Masala base
steps.instruction: Heat oil; temper mustard and curry leaves. Sauté onion until golden, then ginger-garlic paste. Add tomato and cook to a soft mash.

steps.title: Kat (gravy)
steps.instruction: Add chilli powder, goda masala, tamarind, jaggery, and reserved liquid plus water. Simmer 10 minutes for a sharp, spicy gravy.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.instruction: Layer sprouts in bowls, ladle hot kat, top with farsan, chopped onion, coriander, and lemon. Serve with pav if desired.

recipes.name: Bhel-Inspired Puffed Rice Chaat
recipes.description: Crisp puffed rice tossed with onion, tomato, chutneys, and sev — a street-style snack made for home assembly.
recipes.notes: Assemble just before eating so murmura stays crunchy. Skip sev for a lighter gluten-free lean.

steps.title: Prep toppings
steps.instruction: Dice onion, tomato, and potato. Keep chutneys ready.

steps.title: Crisp murmura
steps.instruction: If puffed rice is soft, warm it dry in a pan for 1–2 minutes, then cool.

steps.title: Toss
steps.instruction: In a wide bowl, combine murmura, potato, onion, tomato, peanuts, chutneys, spices, lemon, and salt. Toss quickly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Fold in most of the sev, plate immediately, and finish with coriander and extra sev.

recipes.name: Mixed Vegetable Pakora
recipes.description: Crisp chickpea-flour fritters with onion, spinach, and shredded vegetables — tea-time frying classic.
recipes.notes: Batter should coat vegetables thickly; add water sparingly. Reheat leftovers in an air fryer or oven.

steps.title: Mix vegetables
steps.instruction: Combine sliced onion, spinach, carrot, chilli, coriander, salt, and spices. Rest 5 minutes so onions release moisture.

steps.title: Batter
steps.instruction: Add besan and ajwain. Sprinkle water just until a thick, sticky batter coats the vegetables.

steps.title: Fry
steps.instruction: Heat oil to medium-high. Drop irregular clumps; fry until deep golden and crisp, turning once. Drain on paper.
steps.tip: Fry a test piece first — if it browns too fast, lower the heat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Serve hot with green chutney and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Potato Bonda
recipes.description: Soft spiced potato balls dipped in besan batter and deep-fried until golden — South Indian tea snack.
recipes.notes: Also called batata vada when sandwiched in pav; here served as bonda balls.

steps.title: Potato filling
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp oil; temper mustard, curry leaves, chilli, ginger, and asafoetida. Add onion briefly, then mashed potato, turmeric, salt, and coriander. Cool and shape into balls.

steps.title: Batter
steps.instruction: Whisk besan with remaining turmeric, salt, and water to a smooth coating batter.

steps.title: Fry bondas
steps.instruction: Dip each ball in batter and deep-fry on medium heat until evenly golden. Drain well.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Serve hot with coconut chutney or tomato ketchup.

recipes.name: Medu Vada
recipes.description: Crisp-outside, soft-inside urad dal doughnuts with pepper, curry leaves, and ginger.
recipes.notes: Soak dal 4 hours. Batter should be thick and airy — whip by hand before shaping.

steps.title: Soak and grind
steps.instruction: Soak urad dal 4 hours. Drain and grind with minimal water to a thick, fluffy paste. Add salt and whip 2–3 minutes.

steps.title: Season
steps.instruction: Fold in chilli, ginger, crushed pepper, chopped curry leaves, and optional onion.

steps.title: Shape
steps.instruction: Wet hands, shape doughnuts with a hole in the center on wet banana leaf or plastic.

steps.title: Fry
steps.instruction: Slide into medium-hot oil. Fry until deep golden and crisp outside. Serve with sambar and coconut chutney.
steps.tip: Oil too hot browns outside before the center cooks.

recipes.name: Cardamom Chai Biscuits
recipes.description: Crisp eggless short biscuits scented with green cardamom — made to dunk into masala chai.
recipes.notes: Chai-pairing bakery snack; store airtight up to a week.

steps.title: Rub dough
steps.instruction: Rub cold butter into flour, sugar, cardamom, baking powder, and salt until sandy. Bind with milk into a soft dough. Chill 20 minutes.

steps.title: Shape
steps.instruction: Roll to 5 mm thickness. Cut rounds or rectangles. Place on a lined tray.

steps.title: Bake
steps.instruction: Bake at 170°C for 15–18 minutes until pale golden at the edges. Cool completely to crisp.
steps.tip: Serve beside hot masala chai — dunk, do not soak.

recipes.name: Sabudana Khichdi
recipes.description: Pearl tapioca pearls tossed with peanut, potato, and green chilli — light fasting-friendly breakfast.
recipes.notes: Soak sabudana until pearls swell and crush easily between fingers — usually 3–4 hours with just enough water.

steps.title: Soak
steps.instruction: Rinse sabudana, drain, add just enough water to cover, and soak until soft. Drain any leftover water and toss with peanut powder.

steps.title: Temper
steps.instruction: Heat ghee; add cumin and curry leaves. Add diced potato and chilli; cook until potato is tender.

steps.title: Toss
steps.instruction: Add sabudana mix, salt, and sugar. Stir gently on medium heat until pearls turn translucent, 5–7 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Off heat, add lemon and coriander. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Besan Chilla
recipes.description: Savory chickpea-flour pancakes studded with onion and tomato — quick protein-forward breakfast.
recipes.notes: Batter thickness like dosa; rest 5 minutes before cooking.

steps.title: Batter
steps.instruction: Whisk besan with water until lump-free. Stir in vegetables, spices, salt, and coriander.

steps.title: Cook
steps.instruction: Heat a nonstick pan, oil lightly, pour a ladle, and spread into a thin pancake. Cook until edges lift, drizzle oil, flip, and cook until spotted.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Serve hot with mint chutney or ketchup. Repeat with remaining batter.

recipes.name: Onion Uttapam
recipes.description: Thick fermented rice-lentil pancakes topped with onion and chilli — soft South Indian breakfast.
recipes.notes: Use leftover idli/dosa batter. Instant rava batter works in a pinch with baking soda.

steps.title: Topping
steps.instruction: Finely chop onion, chilli, tomato, and coriander. Season lightly with salt.

steps.title: Spread
steps.instruction: Heat a tawa. Pour a thick round of batter (do not spread thin). Scatter topping on top and press gently.

steps.title: Cook
steps.instruction: Drizzle oil around edges. Cover 1–2 minutes, flip carefully, and cook until both sides are golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Serve with coconut chutney and sambar.

recipes.name: Rava Idli
recipes.description: Steamed semolina idlis with tempering and yogurt — no overnight fermentation required.
recipes.notes: Rest batter 10–15 minutes so rava hydrates before steaming.

ingredients.name: eno fruit salt or baking soda

steps.title: Temper rava
steps.instruction: Heat oil; add mustard, chana dal, cashews, curry leaves, chilli, and ginger. Add rava and roast 3–4 minutes until aromatic.

steps.title: Batter
steps.instruction: Cool slightly. Mix with yogurt, water, salt, carrot, and coriander into a thick pourable batter. Rest 15 minutes.

steps.title: Steam
steps.instruction: Stir in eno just before steaming. Pour into greased idli moulds and steam 10–12 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Unmould and serve with coconut chutney and sambar.

recipes.name: Bread Pakora
recipes.description: Potato-stuffed bread triangles dipped in spiced besan and fried crisp — monsoon chai companion.
recipes.notes: Use day-old sandwich bread for cleaner cuts and less oil absorption.

steps.title: Filling
steps.instruction: Mash potatoes with chilli, ginger, chaat masala, half the chilli powder, salt, and coriander.

steps.title: Sandwich
steps.instruction: Spread filling between two bread slices. Trim crusts if desired and cut into triangles.

steps.title: Batter and fry
steps.instruction: Whisk besan with remaining spices, ajwain, salt, and water. Dip triangles and deep-fry until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Drain and serve immediately with green chutney and hot chai.

recipes.name: Dahi Bhalla
recipes.description: Soft lentil fritters soaked in whisked yogurt and finished with sweet-sour chutneys and spices.
recipes.notes: Soak fried bhallas in warm water before yogurt so they stay soft and mild.

steps.title: Batter
steps.instruction: Soak dals 4 hours. Grind with ginger and chilli to a thick fluffy paste. Whip with salt.

steps.title: Fry bhallas
steps.instruction: Drop small rounds into medium-hot oil; fry until golden. Soak in warm salted water 20 minutes, then gently squeeze.

steps.title: Yogurt
steps.instruction: Whisk yogurt with sugar, a little salt, and water to pouring consistency.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.instruction: Arrange bhallas in a dish, cover with yogurt, drizzle both chutneys, and dust with cumin, chaat masala, and chilli powder. Chill briefly before serving.

recipes.name: Jeera Mathri
recipes.description: Flaky cumin-flecked savory crackers fried until crisp — a classic chai-time namkeen.
recipes.notes: Chai snack pairing. Fry low and slow so mathri cooks through without darkening too fast. Store airtight 2 weeks.

steps.title: Rub fat
steps.instruction: Mix flour, sooji, salt, cumin, ajwain, and pepper. Rub in ghee until the mix holds shape when pressed (moyan).

steps.title: Knead
steps.instruction: Add water gradually to a stiff dough. Rest covered 20 minutes.

steps.title: Shape
steps.instruction: Roll small discs about 4–5 mm thick. Prick with a fork so they do not puff.

steps.title: Fry
steps.instruction: Fry on low–medium heat until pale golden and crisp throughout. Cool completely before storing. Pair with masala chai.
steps.tip: High heat browns outside while the center stays raw.
